get.summary: Observe desktop connectivity without opening chats or running inference
get.description: Performs a same-user desktop IPC handshake with a three-second timeout. Missing, refused, timed-out, or incompatible connections return connected=false. The observation does not guarantee availability for a later action and does not change the queue. Requires a loopback Host, no foreign Origin or cross-site request, and the local-client header. Responses are not cached.

403.description: Request is not from a trusted local client
